Name: KyuubiSoftAPI
Description: REST API for KyuubiSoft Panel - player data (real health/gamemode), real per-world TPS and tick time, player actions (heal/respawn/kill/teleport/gamemode/give via in-process commands, clear-inventory directly on the player's world thread), real-time events (per-world tps_update, player_death with killer, periodic player_position with real ping), and Prometheus metrics. Every request needs the panel's bearer token.
